name: checkout-availability
comment: Availability measured as successful HTTP 2xx responses / total requests. 1440 failures in the current 30-day window. Budget is partially consumed — two payment-gateway timeout incidents in the last 10 days.

name: checkout-p95-latency
comment: Good event = checkout completes in < 2000ms. Current p95 is ~2400ms after a slow inventory-service rollout. Budget is exhausted — 22480 requests exceeded the latency threshold vs. 10789 allowed.

name: payment-gateway-error-rate
comment: Good event = payment request does not return a 5xx or gateway timeout. Currently healthy — only 650 gateway errors this window vs. 1079 allowed.

name: inventory-lock-availability
comment: Inventory reservation availability SLO. Healthy — 870 lock failures vs. 1084 allowed.

name: notification-delivery-rate
comment: Good event = order confirmation email delivered within 60 seconds. A sendgrid integration issue from 2026-03-15 caused a bulk delivery failure. Budget is exhausted.
